prompt.project_info: Brightly lit three-person gym mirror selfie adapted from the source prompt and folder context.
prompt.main_subject: Three clearly adult original women standing close together in a gym: left woman in a dark-gray sports bra and matching shorts holds the smartphone and smiles; center woman in a beige sports bra and matching shorts looks toward the phone; right woman in a taupe sports bra and olive-green shorts leans in with a broad smile. Their faces and skin show a natural post-workout sheen.
prompt.composition_elements: Medium mirror-selfie frame with the trio centered, phone held by the left woman, full reflections and gym equipment visible; bright mirrors, weight machines and racks provide the background.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Bright even overhead lighting, clean commercial gym atmosphere, candid group energy and realistic reflections.
prompt.technical_specs: Photorealistic smartphone mirror selfie, medium shot, accurate mirror geometry, natural skin/fabric/sweat detail and correct separation of three bodies.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: Bright photorealistic medium gym mirror selfie of three clearly adult original women standing close together, left in dark-gray sports bra and shorts holding a smartphone, center in beige sports bra and shorts looking at the phone, right in taupe sports bra and olive-green shorts leaning in and smiling, natural sweaty post-workout sheen, bright mirrors, weight machines and racks, clean even lighting and realistic reflections.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, celebrity likeness, biometric identity, logos, text, watermark, duplicate subjects, merged limbs, extra fingers, distorted reflections, plastic skin, deformed anatomy
